description: This file defines synchronization utilities for API locking, including thread-local flags, lock management templates, and registration functions for API methods, primarily used for thread-safe plugin communication in a C++ project.

classes.name: ApiLocks
classes.description: Template struct managing a static recursive mutex for each class type to ensure thread-safe API access.

classes.name: UnlockApiGuard
classes.description: RAII guard that unlocks the API mutex upon construction if the thread is using a locked API, and re-locks it upon destruction.

classes.name: LockApiGuard
classes.description: RAII guard that manages locking and unlocking of the API mutex, providing explicit lock and unlock methods.

methods.name: getFunctionToCall
methods.description: Creates a std::function that wraps a method call with mutex locking and exception handling, setting a thread-local flag.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApi
methods.description: Registers a method with the plugin's JSONRPC interface, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForVersions
methods.description: Registers a method with versioning support, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForHandler
methods.description: Registers a method with a JSONRPC handler, ensuring thread safety.
